# xload

> Fast, free and safe downloads for browser userscripts

xload is a catalog of free, open-source browser userscripts. Every script installs in one click with a userscript manager such as Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey, and all code is public on GitHub at https://github.com/u2222223/xload.

Catalog: https://xload.net/

## Userscripts

- [ClipSaver for TED](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-7fbc64722d0d/xload-7fbc64722d0d.html): Adds a download button to TED talk pages that opens a download launcher for the

- [XenForo Ignore Members & Content Toolkit](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-39668868585d/xload-39668868585d.html): Hide ignored members, reactions, tags, ranks, badges and signatures across
- [多引擎翻译助手](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-1c9e7dbfe0ae/xload-1c9e7dbfe0ae.html): 选中或输入文本后，调用谷歌、有道、微信等多种引擎完成文本翻译与整页翻译。
- [自定义搜索增强](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-4ea75cfc1263/xload-4ea75cfc1263.html): 使用可自定义的搜索引擎列表快速搜索选中文本，支持站点限定与整页地址等占位符。
- [二维码生成器](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-1a308d5fa609/xload-1a308d5fa609.html): 将选中文本或输入的网址、文字一键生成二维码，支持尺寸与容错级别设置。
- [文本朗读助手](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-b52c81e0639f/xload-b52c81e0639f.html): 使用浏览器语音合成朗读选中或输入的文本，可调节语速、音调、音量与语言。
- [页面阅读增强](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-c93d9b5d8b47/xload-c93d9b5d8b47.html): 为任意网页提供暗黑模式、护眼遮罩、解除复制限制、明文显示密码、网页编辑与屏幕取色等阅读辅助功能。
- [页面调试助手](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-90417d328263/xload-90417d328263.html): 在页面上屏蔽指定元素、加载元素间距标注工具、执行自定义脚本并查看页面调试信息。
- [Link Shortener Bypass Toolkit](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-01859a28d74d/xload-01859a28d74d.html): Skips link shorteners and ad-gate pages to reach the final destination
- [Archive Journey Stats](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-f1e07d282871/xload-f1e07d282871.html): Build per-year creator and reader statistics from your works, inbox and reading
